**What was reviewed:** the `work/w108` branch is gone, so I took the commits from the current history between "ready -> claimed" and "claimed -> done". There is one, `e00780e`, which matches what the implementer's result lists. All four files it touches are in the work-item's fileset.

The plan said to print `...holds no version: it is empty`, and the report doesn't mention the change.
